methods.name: GANomaly
methods.summary: A semi-supervised anomaly detection framework based on Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) that uses an encoder-decoder-encoder sub-network to learn normal patterns and identify deviations (anomalies) by comparing input images against reconstructions and latent space representations.
methods.verbatim: In this study, customed Python scripts were developed for image processing and DL analysis, utilizing the GANomaly model from GitHub repository (Akcay 2024). ... Akcay S. 2024. GANomaly GitHub [WWW Document]. [accessed 2024 Sept 29]. https://github.com/samet-akcay/ganomaly.

availability.author_statement: Data availability statement present with shared links.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom code used for the GANomaly method lacks a repository link in the provided artifact information.
